Every road Christine’s family took. The Wintrodes leave Bammental, near Heidelberg,
land at Philadelphia in 1732, and settle at Frederick, Littlestown and Gettysburg before going west to Illinois,
Iowa and South Dakota. The Fritzes come from Alsace to Tiffin, Ohio, and on to Iowa;
the Staebells and Phillipses from the Alsatian village of Stundwiller to Freeport,
Illinois; the Schmitts from Bavaria. The Jacksons come east from Saint Louis to Hoboken and Brooklyn,
where the Duffys already are. Last come the Maksimows: from Luga, in Russia, to Weener and Varel in Germany,
and in 1956 from Hamburg to Paterson, New Jersey.
